title: Observational monthly climate record (CHIRPS v3 / CHIRTS-ERA5)
description: Monthly precipitation totals and temperature from CHIRPS v3 and CHIRTS-ERA5 over Africa, 1981 to present, as COGs, plus seasonal sums.

transfer.rationale: Public HTTP archive; R/observational/1 already maintains a per-file manifest with sha256 and uses it as a resume gate.

changelog.change: Record created. Note this is the one dataset in the repo that already has a real per-file checksum manifest - the pattern the rest should follow.
Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.
origin.license cleared - the CDH record owns licence, citation and caveats (one owner per field).

acquire.note: That script already maintains its own per-file manifest.csv with sha256 and uses it as a resume gate - the pattern the rest of the catalogue should converge on.
